app.name: Yao
app.one_liner: An open-source runtime for building AI agents and web applications shipped as a single binary.

screens.name: Chat UI (CUI)
screens.purpose: Built-in conversation interface for interacting with AI agents.

screens.name: SUI Pages
screens.purpose: Component-based web UI with server-side rendering for full-stack applications.

rust_commands.name: delegate_agent
rust_commands.purpose: Delegate tasks to specialist agents or run multiple agents in parallel.

rust_commands.name: manage_api_keys
rust_commands.purpose: Handle API key management for external LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.

rust_commands.name: run_hook
rust_commands.purpose: Execute TypeScript Create or Next hooks within the V8 engine to intercept and process agent requests.

mvp_plan: week 1: Create SUI page linked to model
week 1: Set up Yao runtime binary
week 2: Add Create Hook for input validation
week 2: Add Next Hook for output processing
week 2: Configure LLM executor with OpenAI
acceptance_tests: Agent executes a CLI sandboxed command (e.g., code generation) and returns result securely.
API keys are managed securely and used to authenticate with external LLM providers.
Multi-agent delegation works in parallel with session-scoped memory isolation.
Pure Hook routes request deterministically without invoking AI.
User can send a message via CUI and receive a response from an LLM-powered agent.
